sources.name: ADB-WTO Trade in Critical Minerals database
sources.coverage: 500 flows for 2024, the largest 500 per mineral by value out of 3740 found. Bilateral trade by HS code, aggregated to one flow per mineral, country pair and supply-chain stage. Direction follows the exporter's report; pairs with no export row are filled from the importer's mirror and marked low confidence. Values are traded values, not estimates.

sources.name: ICMM Global Mining Dataset
sources.coverage: 1229 facility records across 1229 site-stages, of which 551 are low confidence. Geocoded mines, plants, smelters and refineries, with ICMM's own confidence rating carried through. A site that does more than one thing appears once per stage at the same coordinates.

sources.name: Hand-authored seed dataset: prices
sources.coverage: Indicative annual average prices, order-of-magnitude only, used where no price source covers a mineral.

sources.name: World Bank country API
sources.coverage: 211 countries. Capital-city coordinates used as country-level arc endpoints, plus the canonical country names the ETL matches source spellings against. Not polygon centroids.

sources.name: World Bank Commodity Markets Pink Sheet
sources.coverage: Annual averages of the monthly Pink Sheet series, in US dollars per tonne. Covers copper.
